title: The Last Taxi
prompt: Oscar was sitting reading his newspaper when he heard a noise. When he realized what had happened, he bitterly regretted not having caught the taxi in time. Shortly afterwards, he killed himself.
solution: Oscar was broke. He collected miniature model cars and, to solve his money problems, was going to sell his most valuable one. He had been cleaning it and did not put it down on the table properly. When he sat down and began to read, he heard it fall off the table. He could not catch it in time before it smashed on the floor.
